subject.title: MEDIA: directive with absolute local paths outside default media roots silently fails (Telegram)

question: Should #100292 be scoped to diagnostics for dropped Telegram `MEDIA:` paths while #47002 owns configurable root expansion, or should this issue also define the host-root policy?
rationale: The diagnostics improvement is local, but allowing additional host-local paths changes a security-sensitive file-read/upload contract and overlaps an open canonical root-policy issue.

options.title: Diagnostics Here, Roots In #47002
options.body: Keep this issue for warn-level and user-visible dropped-media feedback, while #47002 or the approved filesystem-roots design owns persistent host-root expansion.

options.title: Define Root Policy Here
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical place to specify and implement a supported configurable media-root contract for Telegram replies.

options.title: Close As Managed-Roots Policy
options.body: Treat the current managed-root behavior as intended and require users to use managed paths, structured sends, or the canonical root-policy tracker.

recommendation.title: Diagnostics Here, Roots In #47002
recommendation.body: Keep this issue for warn-level and user-visible dropped-media feedback, while #47002 or the approved filesystem-roots design owns persistent host-root expansion.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on outbound media failure handling and media-access policy.
